verdict.rationale: The docs' llms.txt states that /openapi.json is the machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 specification. An independent probe confirms it is live: HTTP 200 at docs.dev.runwayml.com/openapi.json, and the file contains the "openapi" key. missing for 10: no evidence on the spec's completeness or coverage of all endpoints (e.g., Characters, Workflows, Model Routers), and no hands-on community corroboration of using it with codegen or agent tooling.
